title: Ἀντιγόνη
author: Σοφοκλῆς
description: The Greek text of Sir Richard Jebb's edition, with his translation, critical notes and commentary, and the Liddell–Scott dictionaries. Tap any word for its meaning and form.
edition: The Antigone of Sophocles, ed. R. C. Jebb, Cambridge University Press, 1891 (Perseus Digital Library)

title: Ἡ Καινὴ Διαθήκη
description: The Greek New Testament in the SBL edition of Michael W. Holmes with its apparatus and the Berean Standard Bible. Tap any word for its meaning and form in Abbott-Smith's and Dodson's lexicons of the New Testament and the Liddell–Scott dictionaries, or hold it for the syntax of its sentence; the lemmas, morphology and syntax are those of the MACULA Greek project.
edition: The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition, ed. Michael W. Holmes, Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software 2010

title: Ὀδύσσεια
author: Ὅμηρος
description: The Greek text of T. W. Allen's Oxford edition with its critical apparatus, A. T. Murray's translation, the commentary of Merry, Riddell and Monro, and the Liddell–Scott dictionaries. Tap any word for its meaning and form.
edition: Homeri Opera III-IV, ed. T. W. Allen, 2nd ed., Oxford 1917-1919

title: Συμπόσιον
author: Πλάτων
description: The Greek text of John Burnet's Oxford edition with its critical apparatus, Benjamin Jowett's translation, and R. G. Bury's commentary and introduction, with the Liddell–Scott dictionaries. Tap any word for its meaning and form. The analysis of each sentence's syntax is automatic (GLAUx) and has not been checked by hand.
edition: Platonis Opera II, ed. J. Burnet, Oxford 1901 (corrected printing 1910)
